decisionScope: Bounded approval of 11 coarse anatomical surface annotations on the unchanged source geometry. This is not certification of individual constituent bones or exact fused joint boundaries.

groups.scope: PASS for gross rib and sternum surface complex. Individual ribs, costal cartilage, sternebrae and fine contacts are unresolved.
PASS for gross vertebral column including reviewed caudal exit processes. Regional and serial vertebral boundaries are unresolved; small contacts remain neutral.
PASS for complete gross skull and upper/lower jaw complex. Constituent bones, sutures and separate mandible identity are not certified.
PASS for gross pectoral plate complex after proximal humerus spill removal. Constituent scapular, clavicular and coracoid boundaries are unresolved.

PASS for gross pelvic plate complex after narrowed femoral interfaces and neutralized ventral caudal strip. Small remaining gold/neutral contact fragments are unresolved interfaces; no individual sacral or epipubic identity is certified.
PASS for gross humerus surface family after body precedence removes girdle spill. Exact fused joint contacts remain unresolved. Gray humerus hue is applicable at this family scope.
PASS for gross paired forearm surface region between elbow and wrist, with neutral joint bands. Radius and ulna are combined; individual identities and precise articular boundaries are not certified.

PASS for gross distal hand complex after removal of false elevated palm seed and downward wrist clipping. Carpals, metacarpals and phalanges are combined. This is a Generalia composite color borrowing Gray carpal hue, not a sourced whole-hand Gray slot.
PASS for gross femur surface family after body precedence removes pelvic spill. Exact proximal and distal fused articular boundaries remain unresolved.

PASS for gross paired hind shank and ankle-contact surface region. Teal includes prominent ankle/heel projections of unresolved constituent identity; do not claim exact complete tibia/fibula-only boundaries.

PASS for gross distal foot surface complex after downward ankle clipping. Tarsals, metatarsals and phalanges are combined; proximal ankle-contact projections remain in the adjacent coarse shank/ankle region. This is a Generalia composite extension, not individual tarsal identity.

evidence: All four refreshed browser whole views in work/combined-colors: dorsal, ventral, lateral, oblique.
All 33 refreshed close group views: dorsal, ventral and oblique for each of the 11 groups.
Neutral source multi-view renders and actual ray hit coordinates, including removal of false elevated right palm seed.
Earlier rejected cycles and subsequent actual geometry boundary corrections retained in work/color-review.
Saved Biodiversity benchmark and zoom screenshots inspected directly for color readability comparison.

observations: Skull purple, column lavender, cage cyan, pectoral green, pelvis gold, proximal limb blues and distal pinks distinguish broad anatomical regions against the dark background.
Forearm and hind shank reuse teal, while hand and foot pinks are similar; their spatial positions and labels should provide identity. Do not rely on hue alone.

Biodiversity benchmark has finer geometry and more constituent colors. Current display achieves clear coarse regional presentation without claiming equivalent scientific segmentation or source detail.
Whole candidate skeleton is relatively small in review frames; final public framing and legend usability require separate review.

limitations: Source is a fused artist mesh with generic rig controls, not a specimen-derived individual-bone segmentation.
Anatomical approval is based on visible gross geometry across multiple views; no rig label or bounding box is treated as bone identity.
Neutral contacts, small digit tips, and uncertain surface slivers remain intentionally unresolved. Colored percentage is coverage, not an accuracy percentage.
Skull sutures, serial vertebrae, girdle constituents, radius versus ulna, tibia versus fibula, and individual manus/pes bones are not certified.
Hind shank scope includes unresolved ankle/heel projections and pelvic scope includes unresolved contact fragments; public names must reflect these limits.
Exact geometry preservation is supported by the reviewed triangle correspondence and renderer permutation design; this report does not certify unrelated pose or skin alignment changes.
Final renamed IDs may change but every approved triangle membership array must remain exactly equal to this pinned candidate. Final Blender/public viewer presentation remains to be reviewed.
